methodology.cpu_api: fresh stdlib zlib.decompress each call; ndarray np.frombuffer and memoryview reuse that fresh bytes storage
methodology.cpu_time: calling thread_time_ns; counter snapshots bracket the timed call
methodology.cuda_api: cuda_zlib.decompress_zlib_host; successful return is public status-check evidence, no raw metadata returned
methodology.cuda_outputs: ndarray/memoryview share completed JAX-owned pinned storage; bytes adds tobytes allocation/copy
methodology.faults: minor/major_faults are process-wide deltas and may include concurrent JAX activity
methodology.limits: single-file synchronous API; no batch, pipelining or GPU-only claim; no affinity/thread environment forced
methodology.ordering: all six series shuffled once per round, warmups first, random.Random(order_seed + output_bytes)
methodology.scope: full synchronous public host-input decompression plus consumer conversion
methodology.timing_excludes: fixture generation, initialization/build, output release, post-timing oracle comparisons
methodology.timing_includes: host compressed input, public API validation, upload, native decode/status check, pinned download, consumer conversion
methodology.validation: every warmup/sample byte-exact after timer; ndarray/memoryview checks do not call tobytes
